about: All fork work in flight. Nodes carry the handoff: every node not done/parked has a 'next' step a cold session can pick up without chat history. WORK_LEDGER.md is the logbook of finished work.
rules: Never delete a node. Finished -> 'done'; abandoned -> 'parked' with the reason in 'next'.
Every node not 'done' or 'parked' must have a concrete 'next' step that anyone could pick up cold.
'needs' lists ids this node waits on; keep it acyclic.
Update 'status', 'next', and 'updated' in the same commit as the work, and at the end of every working session.
Run python3 .agents/check_tracking.py before committing changes here or to the ledger.

nodes.title: Identify ragesaq's printer model and confirm its wireless channel (BLE vs classic-BT SPP)
nodes.next: Done. Printer is a NIIMBOT B1 Pro: catalogue id 4097, 300 dpi, 48 mm printable, 567 px head, B1 series, unverified in Thermalith's catalogue (a hardware verification report is a bonus contribution). Wireless channel = BLE: the B1 Pro's MCU is a SiFli SF32 (modern BLE SoC, per community wiki hardware page) and niimblue drives id 4097 over Web Bluetooth. Consistent with issue #13: newer models are BLE-first. Final on-hardware confirmation (GATT service e7810a71-... visible, SPP absent/silent) folds into ragesaq-004 hardware verification.

nodes.title: Implement BleTransport behind INiimbotTransport in Niimbot.Net
nodes.next: Branch from upstream/main. Target hardware: ragesaq's B1 Pro (id 4097, 300 dpi, 567 px, B1 series - confirm which print task id 4097 maps to; 300 dpi path was proven by D11_H). New transport: GATT discovery (service e7810a71-73ae-499d-8c15-faa9aef0c3f2 / characteristic bef8d6c9-9c21-4c9e-b632-bd58c1009f9f, fallback rule: long-UUID service with NOTIFY + WRITE_NO_RESPONSE characteristic), subscribe notifications, write-without-response, reassemble 55 55 ... Hardware verification on the B1 Pro doubles as the catalogue verification report (model-id + dpi + head px reconcile), worth noting in the PR.
